title: Tesla Earnings WTF
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: A likely SpaceX buyout at a premium ($420-550 floated) acts like a put option under TSLA.
Data-center demand for Megapacks and storage suggests green energy comes back big regardless of 2028 politics.

calls.reason: Earnings beat with better auto margins, FSD take-rate/ARR and record backlog; the 5M-vehicle 2030 target drives a $740-854 2030 value in his model, and a SpaceX buyout at $420-550 gives a floor. Offsets: ~4.7 PEG says fair value nearer $170, op margin 2.6%, heavy capital raising ahead.
calls.quote: this earnings call and earnings report was broadly bullish for many reasons. If there is any temporary sell-off in Tesla, maybe it's because Elon secretly wants to pick up them Tesla shares

notes: Recorded after Tesla's Q3 earnings (stock -2.4% after hours). Short-term 'mixed': after-hours dip he calls temporary. Long-term target 740 is his 2030 model at 20% margin (854 at 25%); he also says on PEG alone it's ~2.2x too expensive (~$170) but doesn't expect that soon because of the SpaceX premium. Medium-term bullish inferred from the acquisition 'put option' ($420-550). Price 386 from his PE calc; he also uses $375 as a purchase price.
